environmentAndLaunchLines.text: /bin/su -s /bin/sh -c "export HOME=/home/admin USER=admin LOGNAME=admin DISPLAY=:0; exec /bin/Xfbdev :0 -ac -maxbigreqsize 1 -screen '$screen_mode' -nolisten tcp -fp /share/fonts/X11/misc,/share/fonts/X11/cursor" admin &
/bin/su -s /bin/sh -c 'export HOME=/home/admin USER=admin LOGNAME=admin DISPLAY=:0; exec /bin/aurora-files --picker-service' admin &

/bin/su -s /bin/sh -c "export HOME=$home USER=$account LOGNAME=$account DISPLAY=:0 XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$home/.config XDG_CACHE_HOME=$home/.cache; exec /bin/firefox --no-remote --new-instance -profile /home/admin/.mozilla/firefox/http1-profile" "$account"
# NSS creates fresh databases itself; existing profile trust is left intact.
echo "[NSS_CA_DB] static Nightly roots; preserving existing profile databases" >&2
if [ ! -x /bin/wait-for-aurora ] || ! /bin/su -s /bin/sh -c 'export HOME=/home/admin USER=admin LOGNAME=admin DISPLAY=:0; exec /bin/wait-for-aurora' admin; then
/bin/su -s /bin/sh -c 'export HOME=/home/admin USER=admin LOGNAME=admin DISPLAY=:0; exec /bin/aurora-wm --compositor=no' admin
exec /bin/su -s /bin/sh -c 'export HOME=/home/admin USER=admin LOGNAME=admin DISPLAY=:0; exec /bin/xterm -ls -e htop' admin

findings: The exact final image1 /init sets PATH=/bin:/sbin:/usr/bin:/usr/sbin and exports it. It sets SHELL=/bin/sh and starts the desktop account through /bin/su without a login flag.
No checked system/admin/root profile file or etc/profile.d shell script is present in this image. The persistent mounted home may still contain user configuration; this audit does not inspect it.
The frontend desktop init wrapper sets DISPLAY and starts bridge/agent helpers, then execs /init.desktop-original; it does not override PATH.

The guest-specific WM build adapter replaces its upstream host fork/bash PTY implementation with the wasm32 Aurora Files posix_spawn implementation. That implementation selects SHELL with /bin/sh fallback, passes only argv0, inherits environ, and changes TERM but not PATH.
The native sudo source explicitly resets PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin before execvp. Its command lookup therefore cannot prove ordinary nonroot terminal lookup.
limits: No guest boot or ordinary command-resolution execution was performed.
The available terminal source/build adapter was audited; this receipt does not independently bind its source to the already deployed Aurora executable.
BusyBox su environment behavior and persisted user configuration can affect the effective shell PATH; do not infer runtime selection solely from init.
This is source evidence for the next normal uid1000/no-force package acceptance gate. It does not promote the plain candidate.
